subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The live_preview config object is cast to `as any` without an explanatory comment: `{ live_preview: { enable: true, preview_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN } as any }`. TypeScript strict compliance rules require that any untyped `any` be accompanied by an explanatory comment. The cast is likely needed because `contentstack.Config` does not include `live_preview` in its type definition, but the reason is not documented.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an explanatory comment such as `// contentstack.Config type does not include live_preview; cast required until SDK types are updated` or use module augmentation to extend the `contentstack.Config` type with `live_preview?: { enable?: boolean; preview_token?: string }`.

issues.description: The `live_preview` interface field only includes `enable` and `preview_token`, but AC 3 prescribes that `preview_hash` context should flow through to Contentstack queries. The `setCommonConfig` method forwards `preview_token` (the SDK initialization token) as the query param value via `query.addParam("live_preview", live_preview.preview_token)`, but Contentstack live preview queries expect the `preview_hash` from the URL, not the `preview_token`. This means draft content will never be fetched even with this change.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `preview_hash?: string` to the `live_preview` field in `ICommonContentstackConfig`, and in `setCommonConfig` forward `preview_hash` instead of `preview_token`: `if (live_preview?.preview_hash) { query.addParam("live_preview", live_preview.preview_hash); }`

issues.description: No test verifies that `setCommonConfig` forwards `live_preview` context to Contentstack queries via `query.addParam`. The contentstack mock does not include `addParam`, so if any test passed `live_preview` config to a query, it would throw a runtime error. AC 4 and learned review rules require coverage for live_preview context forwarding through to queries, not just Stack-level configuration.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `addParam: jest.fn().mockReturnThis()` to the contentstack mock object, and add a test that calls `getEntry` or `getSingleEntry` with a `live_preview` config and asserts `addParam` was called with the correct preview hash value.

issues.description: `live_preview.preview_token as string` is an unsafe cast. The interface defines `preview_token` as `string | undefined`. If `live_preview` is truthy but `preview_token` is undefined, this passes `undefined` to `addParam`, which could cause unexpected behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Guard with `if (live_preview?.preview_token)` (or `preview_hash` per the major fix above) before calling `addParam`, eliminating the need for the `as string` cast.
